props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Small eyebrow line above the headline. Default "", from the component source.

props.name: headline
props.description: Names the dialog on the web (aria-label) and renders as the heading. Left empty, the modal has no heading and no name. Declared: Large hero headline. Default "", from the component source.

props.name: supportingText
props.description: Supporting paragraph shown below the headline. Default "", from the component source.

props.name: priceText
props.description: Secondary line below the supporting paragraph (e.g. a price / timeline). Default "", from the component source.

props.name: heroMedia
props.description: A full-bleed background at the root, pinned to the top at the modal's width (height = width ÷ an Image's ratio), behind the hero text, the body and the footer. It adds no scroll height and moves with the scroll. Declared: Full-bleed background media for the whole modal. It is pinned to the top and laid out at the full modal width; size it with an aspect ratio (e.g. `<Image ratio={1080 / 4140} />`) so its height follows the width naturally. It renders as a single continuous background BEHIND both the hero text and the body content — there is no separate body box stacked on top of it. Bring any renderer — most commonly an `Image`, but a `LottiePlayer`, `Video`, or `SvgXml` works too. It never intercepts touches and the foreground content scrolls over it (no parallax). `modes` are cascaded into it.

props.name: heroHeight
props.description: The hero text region is 532 px tall by default, as in Figma; the package's own doc comment still says 420. Declared: Height reserved for the hero text region (eyebrow / headline / supporting / price), whose content is anchored to the bottom. Applies whether or not `heroMedia` is present. Defaults to 420. Default 532, from the component source.

props.name: showClose
props.description: The close button (28 × 28, 12 px from the top and right) renders only when showClose and onClose are both set. Declared: Whether to render the floating close button (top-right). Defaults to true. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: closeOffsetY
props.description: Additional vertical offset (in px) applied to the floating close button's top position, on top of the base inset (`12 + safe-area top`). Positive values push it further down. Defaults to 0. Default 0, from the component source.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Shows the close button. On the web, with trapFocus on (the default), a focus trap moves focus inside on mount (to the scrolling body), keeps Tab and Shift+Tab inside, calls onClose on Escape, and returns focus to the opener when the modal is removed. Without onClose it is still aria-modal but doesn't take or keep focus. Declared: Press handler for the close button.

props.name: trapFocus
props.description: With trapFocus false, a modal shown from the first render leaves focus on the page and Tab passes through it; Escape doesn't close it, and it is still a modal dialog. With the default, one shown at load takes focus. Declared: When `true` (default) and `onClose` is set, the modal takes focus and keeps Tab inside itself. Set `false` to show the modal in a frame or preview without a page-wide trap. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: closeAccessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessibility label for the close button. Default "Close", from the component source.

props.name: footer
props.description: Fully custom footer content rendered inside the sticky `ActionFooter`. When provided, `primaryActionLabel` / `disclaimer` are ignored.

props.name: primaryActionLabel
props.description: Empty by default, so there is no footer until a label or a custom footer is given. Declared: Label for the default primary action button in the footer. Default "", from the component source.

props.name: onPrimaryAction
props.description: Press handler for the default primary action button.

props.name: disclaimer
props.description: Disclaimer text shown below the default primary action button. Default "", from the component source.

props.name: children
props.description: The modal's modes cascade into its children, through their children props, but not into a component that doesn't forward modes: a Section inside a wrapper component stays a white card with black text. Declared: Body content (typically `Section`s). `modes` are cascaded automatically.

props.name: modes
props.description: Mode configuration. `Page type` defaults to `'JioPlus'` (overridable here), and `context5` is always forced to `'Fullscreen Modal'` (non-overridable). The resolved modes cascade to the body, hero media, and the `ActionFooter`.

props.name: style
props.description: Style overrides for the outer container.

props.name: contentContainerStyle
props.description: Style overrides for the transparent body wrapper.
